messages:
alice (Support): Hey @acme_integration — we received a support ticket where calls to /v1/generate are returning 403 with message "billing: over quota". Can you paste a curl repro and any request ids? Need minimal SDK snippets too so Eng can repro. Ticket#2279.

acme_integration: thanks, hitting from prod host. here's the curl we used and the raw response. request-id: r-20260312-9a1b2c3d

curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rw_PROD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"summarize this"}'

< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< x-request-id: r-20260312-9a1b2c3d
< content-type: application/json
< date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 15:02:11 GMT
< 
{"error":{"type":"billing_error","message":"billing: quota_exceeded"}}

alice (Support): thanks. can you also paste the response headers and your org id?

acme_integration: headers above include x-request-id and date. org id = org-acme-42

raj (CS): looped in billing, @charlie (Eng Oncall) can you check quota accounting for org-acme-42? :mag:

charlie (Eng Oncall): looking now — I see a large spike in token usage at ~15:00 UTC. Running a quick usage query:
`SELECT * FROM billing.usage WHERE org_id='org-acme-42' AND ts >= "2026-03-12T14:50:00Z"`

charlie (Eng Oncall): query result: client-side loop generated ~1.2M tokens in 5 minutes which would exceed monthly reserved commit and trigger quota enforcement. internal txn id txn-88f7.

maya (SDK): posting minimal SDK repros. Common mistake: using a test key or a rotated key without billing attached. Make sure your key is the active prod key (starts with rw_).

Python minimal repro:
```
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization":"Bearer rw_ABCD...", "Content-Type":"application/json"}
payload = {"model":"redwood-large", "input":"hi"}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

Node (JS) minimal repro:
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
await fetch('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer rw_ABCD...', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-large', input: 'hi' })
}).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

Go minimal repro:
```
package main
import ("net/http"; "strings"; "io/ioutil"; "fmt")
func main(){
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate", strings.NewReader(`{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hi"}`))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer rw_ABCD...")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  res, _ := client.Do(req)
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(res.Body)
  fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(b))
}
```

alice (Support): charlie — can we confirm whether the 403 is from the billing enforcement service or a gateway mis-classifying auth failures? also @acme_integration please re-run curl with `-v` to show full headers if it reoccurs. :pray:

charlie (Eng Oncall): confirmed — enforcement returned 403 with reason "billing: quota_exceeded". enforcement internal_id=enforce-455d. forwarding logs to billing team. internal request ids: [r-20260312-9a1b2c3d, enforce-455d, txn-88f7]

billing-bot: billing-check output for org-acme-42: monthly_commit=1000000, used=1200000, overage=true, billing_status=active

acme_integration: found the bug in our client loop, throttling now and will redeploy. we'll re-run the Python snippet and paste `curl -v` headers if it recurs. thanks for the quick help :bow:

alice (Support): great — if this happens again please collect a debug bundle: `redwoodctl collect --org org-acme-42 --since 2026-03-12T14:50:00Z --out acme-debug.tgz` and upload here. closing this thread for now, but ping us if you see it again. :white_check_mark:
